verdict.rationale: First-party docs say LiveKit Agents has full support for LLM tool use. Developers can build a custom tool library, call external APIs or look up data mid-conversation, and plug in MCP server tools via `MCPToolset` or one line of code. The evidence never addresses how the agent avoids silence while a tool runs; the interruption-handling and turn-detection docs cover barge-ins and end-of-turn timing, not tool latency. Missing for 10: documented filler speech or status updates during long-running tool calls, async/background tool execution that avoids dead air, and independent or hands-on corroboration of tool-call latency in live voice sessions.
